content.short: Zapper is a DeFi portfolio tracker and aggregator for tracking tokens, LP positions, lending positions, and NFTs across dozens of chains including Mantle.
content.description: Zapper is one of DeFi's most widely used portfolio management platforms, enabling users to track the value of their tokens, LP positions, lending balances, and NFTs across dozens of blockchain networks from a single dashboard. The platform provides DeFi discovery tools to find new yield opportunities and allows users to zap into complex positions with a single transaction. Zapper is officially recognized by Mantle Network and supports full portfolio tracking for all Mantle assets and protocols.
content.meta: Zapper is a DeFi portfolio tracker and aggregator for discovering and managing on-chain positions on Mantle. Discover Zapper on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
